text:
(he/him/his)
Ph.D. Student The University of Hong Kong
Email CV






I am a Ph.D. student in the School of Future Media at the University of Hong Kong, supervised by Prof. King-wa Fu and Prof. Bin Chen.
My research focuses on digital journalism, political communication, and platform governance.
Previously, I received an M.A. from Tsinghua University (2025) and a B.A. from Zhejiang University (2022). I also worked as a journalism intern at Caixin Media and The Paper.





In Chinese

Li, Hongtao, Liu, Yusi, Dai, Fankai. (2026). Where’s the Covid-19 testing stations now? Liminal Memoryscape, and Covid-19 Heritage in China’s Urban Space. Communication & Society (TSSCI), 75, 1–36. [Publisher’s Version]
Zhou, Ruiming, Wang, Weijia, Dai, Fankai, & Zhou, Ziluo. (2021). Learning to make news: How Chinese college students and faculty covered the Covid-19 pandemic. Shanghai Journalism Review (CSSCI), 11, 53–65.
